_note: Sample content for demo/testing only. A real deployment must have these passages reviewed by language educators and, ideally, speech-language pathologists before use with children — these are illustrative, not clinically validated.

telugu.text: అమ్మ ఇంటికి వచ్చింది. నాన్న school కి వెళ్ళాడు. పాప పుస్తకం చదివింది.
telugu.translation_note: Mother came home. Father went to school. The girl read a book. Contains one deliberate English code-switch ('school') to test the code-switch filter.

hindi.text: माँ घर आई। पिता स्कूल गए। बच्ची ने पुस्तक पढ़ी।
hindi.translation_note: Mother came home. Father went to school. The girl read a book. Includes one English word 'school' to check code-switch handling.

tamil.text: அம்மா வீட்டுக்கு வந்தார். அப்பா பள்ளிக்கு சென்றார். சிறுமி புத்தகத்தைப் படித்தார்.
tamil.translation_note: Mother came home. Father went to school. The girl read a book. Includes one English word 'school' to test code-switch filtering.

kannada.text: ಅಮ್ಮ ಮನೆಗೆ ಬಂದಳು. ನಾನ್ನ school ಗೆ ಹೋದನು. ಹುಡುಗಿಯು ಪುಸ್ತಕವನ್ನು ಓದಿದಳು.
kannada.translation_note: Mother came home. Father went to school. The girl read a book. Includes one English word 'school' for code-switch testing.
